post.content:
Over the last few months, we’ve been evolving Cháps  to better reflect who we are and where we’re headed, refining our physical and digital touchpoints. 

I’ll be sharing various things from this project starting with our new branding / labels. 

Introducing the new & improved Chapman bottle 🍹

Our goal was to bring the vibrancy and creativity of the Cháps brand to life through our new label design, while incorporating subtle nods to African culture, artistry, and heritage in a modern and refined way 🌍✨

We’ve also addressed a few key barriers to initial comprehension by incorporating flavour iconography and utilising back labels to provide context around the cultural background and history of our drinks.

The same amazing taste you know and love, now with an elevated look and feel 🫶

More posts on the other products coming across the week! 

We Drink Cháps
